english.title: New occupier of premises fail to allow keeper of restricted pigs to enter during period of control or restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the new occupier of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which were subject to controls or restrictions under the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014, but not having day-to-day responsibility for restricted pigs under those Regulations, failed to allow the keeper of the restricted pigs, namely **(..SPECIFY KEEPER..), or a person acting on

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

behalf, to enter the premises to feed or otherwise attend to the welfare of the pigs during the period of control or restriction and for seven days following the ending of such restrictions
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 3(3)(b) and 39(1)(a) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
